title: check-console-intercept-disarm: the workspace parse stops at a comment line, so every ui member is outside the gate and it still prints OK
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbaBjisxkQo9hht9bFB

Filing gate: out-of-scope finding, class (a), reported by the #29353 dev (os-dev-report 6585225367 on #29353, PR #29556) and re-read by the `domain:devx` seat on `main` `8e505db8`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

## What is wrong

`workspacePackageDirs()` in `scripts/check-console-intercept-disarm.mjs` reads the `packages:` list of `pnpm-workspace.yaml` line by line and stops at the first line that is neither a `- glob` item nor blank. The list carries a comment block after `examples/*` (the "objectui tree, once it is imported under ui/" note), so the parse ends there, and the four members below it, `ui`, `ui/packages/*`, `ui/apps/*` and `ui/examples/*`, never enter the gate's population. The gate then reports `OK: N vitest-running package(s), every one disarms…` over the non-ui packages only.

- Seat reading on `main`: 40 `ui/{packages,apps,examples}/*/package.json` manifests, 2 package-root `vitest.config.*` among them, neither carrying a literal `disableConsoleIntercept: true`. The dev measured 40 ui packages that run vitest without the disarm while the gate prints OK.
- The ui suite is the one #10374's late-console teardown race can redden as easily as core's.
- PR #29556 (for #29353) keeps this parse and states in its new `ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS` comment that the ui members are not in the population. Fixing the parse will also need the ui pairs in that declaration, or its drift check reds.

Re-check: `node scripts/check-console-intercept-disarm.mjs` prints a package count; compare it with `pnpm -r ls --depth -1 | wc -l`. Positive control: `grep -n "examples/\*" pnpm-workspace.yaml` hits the last glob the parse reads.

## Wanted

- Parse the `packages:` list so comment lines inside it do not end it (a YAML parser, or skip `#` lines), so the ui members are read.
- Decide each ui package the gate then reports: disarm it at its package root, or record why its runner is not exposed. ⛔ Do not narrow the gate back to the non-ui tree to stay green.
- A self-test case: a workspace file with a comment between globs keeps every glob.

Blocked-by: #29353
Dedupe: searched `console-intercept-disarm ui`, `pnpm-workspace comment parse`: only #29353, #10374. **New.**
